dedupe_keys.name: anonymised ais derived track lines 2014 uk waters marine management organisation

description: This dataset holds anonymised vessel transit lines derived from Automatic Identification System (AIS) messages in UK waters for 2014. The Marine Management Organisation built the track lines to produce its 2014 shipping density grid, from Maritime and Coastguard Agency legacy AIS data for January to April and FCG data for May to December. Coverage is national (UK waters). The data are free under the Open Government Licence and can be downloaded from an S3 link listed on data.gov.uk; the record was last modified in June 2017. Caveats: it covers a single year, vessel identities are removed, the two AIS sources change during the year, and the data are not updated. The track lines support shipping density and route analysis, exposure of shipping lanes to offshore hazards and capacity studies for ports and sea areas. They complement the UK maritime shipping statistics and are related to the Danish Maritime Authority AIS data and the US Marine Cadastre AIS data catalogued here.
name: Anonymised AIS-derived track lines 2014, UK waters (Marine Management Organisation)
